name: When should finish carpentry be scheduled during a garage remodel?

mainEntity.name: When should finish carpentry be scheduled during a garage remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry should only begin after your garage framing, rough electrical, insulation, and drywall taping are fully finished. Attempting to install cabinetry or baseboards over unfinished drywall creates awkward seams and can block access to necessary electrical boxes or wall studs. A practical tradeoff to consider is deciding whether you want the garage ceiling and walls painted before trim goes up. Pre-painting drywall saves significant cutting-in time, while hanging built-in cabinets first allows trim carpenters to integrate crown molding or baseboards seamlessly against the walls.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry is scheduled after framing, insulation, drywall, and painting are done, ensuring solid backing and clean lines for all trims, shelving, and cabinetry.
